reviews.title: Dreadful company!
reviews.body:
Please do not believe any positive reviews here - I do not believe them to be honest reviews from real customers...at least not based on my experience. I implore you, if you value your money or wish for an internet connection, do not use Lebara!  I had the misfortune to buy an esim for use in Egypt. I followed their exact instructions but did not get connected upon arrival. I have now spent literally three hours out of the last 18 hours trying to get connected but the three Lebara staff members have either been deliberately misleading me or are totally incompetent. All three of them - the latest was called Rijo - provided misleading, contradictory solutions. The end result is this: 
1, I'm out of pocket as they've taken my money 
2, I'm not connected to the internet
3, they claim my complaint will take 48 hours to be processed - I'm only here for two weeks so that's a big chunk of my holiday time ruined
4, instead of having a relaxing, but expensive, holiday I'm stressed because I'm wasting precious hours to invisible people on a chat line who will say anything to avoid fixing the problem.
5, I'm having to use the hotel wifi which is very slow so, consequently, I can't do what I wanted to do.
AVOID LEBARA'S ESIM. IT'S VERY SIMPLE - THEY ARE EITHER FRAUDSTERS OR INCOMPETENTS.
I'm not sure which is worse but I certainly feel that I've been conned!

reviews.title: Extremely disappointing experience with…
reviews.body:
Extremely disappointing experience with Lebara.

I switched to Lebara over a month ago and requested to keep my existing mobile number. Despite receiving confirmation that the transfer was underway, the port never completed properly. After more than 32 days, I am still without my original number.

I have contacted customer services approximately 17 times through phone calls and online chat, raised three formal complaints and been told repeatedly that the issue has been escalated as a high priority. Yet nothing has been resolved.

I have been given conflicting information by different advisors, repeatedly promised callbacks that never happen and even advised to purchase a new SIM to resolve the issue, which has also failed.

I have also been unable to access my Lebara account using any of the numbers involved, meaning I cannot manage my plan or purchase additional data.

The customer service experience has been incredibly frustrating. Advisors appear to have very limited information or ability to resolve technical issues, requests to speak to managers or technical teams have gone nowhere, and repeated assurances that someone will call back have proved meaningless.

All I want is for my original number to be transferred correctly, my account access restored and someone at Lebara to finally take ownership of the problem.

I have never experienced anything like this with a mobile provider. I would strongly urge anyone considering switching to Lebara to think carefully about the support available if something goes wrong.

reviews.title: Cheap deals does not automatically include quality service
reviews.body: Their cheap deals are because you will receive appalling unreliable service.  They have been throttling my data since I've been with them and they intensified it when my contract auto renewed after 8 months so that now I am forced to go whole evenings without internet access to way past midnight; webpages take excessively long to load or not at all and I am frequently put in offline status even though I have 100GB a month.  I cannot access important emails or send emails and cannot load internet pages or apps.  Family members informed me their calls are frequently not put through and told my phone is no longer available.  I am unable to tether.  There is definitely a pattern of instability that suggests it's intentional especially since I recently requested my PAC code.  I received a disconcerting call from Lebara shortly after asking me why I requested my PAC as if I'm not allowed to leave their disgusting service.  There is no quality of service and there is always a huge disparity between my phone's data usage information and Lebara's app info that invariably shows that I've consumed practically all my 100GB in approx 2 weeks and even when I have not tethered it claims I've used data tethering.  I have screenshot evidence to back up my claims.

reviews.title: Vulnerable disabled woman in crisis
reviews.body:
Imagine this.. 

A disabled, vulnerable woman has had her bag stolen. Amongst many sentimental things is her mobile and Lebara sim. 

Unfortunately she was unable to request a replacement sim through her online account as the email address has since changed. She had previously requested for the email to be amended on the account. Evidently this hadn’t been done. 

4 live chats, 3 voice calls chasing and 60 hours have now passed. The promised call back has not been attempted. 

A disabled, vulnerable woman is still without her number. Does not know when the replacement sim will be sent. The same SIM card that is required to schedule medication deliveries, confirm weekly hospital appoints and discuss results. 

You should be ashamed.
